title: Install ADUSKILLS with a minimal in-repo footprint
summary: Chose a 14-file / 72 KB control plane inside the serv__ Git repo plus the full 48 MB / 5,728-file bundle outside Git at /home/user/aduskills, rather than vendoring the whole bundle into the repository or keeping it only in ephemeral /tmp.

facts.claim: DECISION: .aduskills/ holds the activation docs, policies, licences, memory, and state (Git-tracked, reviewable). /home/user/aduskills/ holds the full skill library (reachable by path, untracked). A root AGENTS.md points at both.

REJECTED alternative 1 - vendor all 5,728 files into serv__: would consume 57% of the sandbox's ~10,000-file persisted-artifact budget, bury the user's 18-file server under unrelated finance/marketing/C-level libraries, and violate least privilege and no-hidden-expansion.
evidence: bundle top-level dirs include finance/, marketing/, c-level-advisor/, business-*/

facts.claim: REJECTED alternative 2 - leave the bundle in /tmp only: /tmp is ephemeral and not captured in snapshots, so skills and memory would vanish between sessions, breaking ADUSKILLS section 6 memory-loss prevention.
evidence: host persistence rule: only files under /home/user are captured

facts.claim: REJECTED alternative 3 - install nothing and keep the protocol in context only: activation would not survive the session and no handoff or graph memory could persist.
evidence: ACTIVATE.md 'Session state' - activation lasts for the current session and workspace

facts.claim: Trade-off accepted: skills are resolved from an absolute out-of-repo path, so the setup is machine-specific rather than portable with the repo. Documented in state/skills-route.md with the re-fetch source (github.com/Adarshukumar/aduskill, HTTP 200) and the instruction to re-run verify-bundle.py after any re-fetch.

Reversibility: this is an additive change on branch arena/01a0ccca-serv with no tracked file modified, so it can be undone by deleting .aduskills/ and AGENTS.md. Disclosed to the user as assumption A1 in the Intent Contract and offered for reversal.

Related deliberate non-decisions: bundle .mcp.json (tessl) not activated; .claude/settings.json marketplace affaan-m/ECC not enabled; agent-launcher hooks not installed; restricted-defensive-validation left disabled per manifest default.

edges.target: agent, under ADUSKILLS sections 2.5, 2.8, and 4 (harmless reversible detail - default chosen and disclosed)
